annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes The Fortune Miner through unusually high BNB return claims, including 3% daily in the title, up to 11% daily in the narration, and a displayed 3.33% daily and 1215.45% APR offer, while presenting a personal deposit and reported earnings as part of the promotion. The participation flow requires depositing BNB and using repeated compounding, withdrawals, and redeposits, includes a stated 90% tax for claiming without compounding, and connects the system's operation with recruiting additional players. Although the speaker gives high-risk and no-guarantee disclaimers, the discussion describes the project as initially operating as a Ponzi and continues to present referral and participation incentives tied to the miner.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The described participation involves depositing BNB into a contract for a share of a miner-style pool, with claimed daily BNB returns and an incentive to compound. The deposit is investment capital, not an evidenced fee for earning guidance or a purchase of physical mining capacity.
